notes.title: Ver 1.0.5 patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash if you kill yourself at the same time you get a head-throwing chip.
[*] Fixed a problem with the tutorial description of the upper head throw when using the keyboard.
[*] Fixed an issue where some of the backgrounds were off by 1 pixel.
[*] Fixed so that you can unlock achievements without enabling Steam Overlay.
[/list]
